section_hint: Every lane that has to be quick
section_description: One quick model for all of the Keeper's background work
lead: Choose the fast model: the one quick model all of the Keeper's background work runs on — an item's parameters, reviews of a draft, journals, memory, the verifier, the voices of the people you meet, the interface's words in your language, and an object's uses worked out before they are needed.
aside: Nothing these lanes write is the Keeper's prose, so a quick model here shortens every turn without touching a word of the story.
live: A change takes effect on the next lane the table runs, so it reaches a table that is already running without restarting it.
auto_subtitle: Every lane runs on whichever model the Keeper is set to
thinking_lead: Choose the reasoning effort the fast model runs at. A lane that spends its time thinking keeps the player waiting, so the lanes do not follow the table's effort; they run at their own steady level unless you pick one here.
empty: No models in Model Management yet. Sign in a provider there, then come back.
failed: Reading or writing the fast model failed; try again.
